entries.en: A flashing banner ad kept distracting me from the article.
entries.zh: 一则闪烁的网页横幅广告不停地分散我阅读文章时的注意力。

entries.en: The editor shortened the banner headline to fit the front page.
entries.zh: 编辑缩短了头号大标题，以便放在头版上。

entries.meaningZh: 战火的洗礼；首次战斗经历
entries.en: The novel describes a young recruit's baptism of fire during a retreat.
entries.zh: 这部小说描写了一名年轻新兵在撤退期间首次经受战火洗礼的经历。

entries.en: The retired barfly now meets his friends at a quiet cafe.
entries.zh: 那位退休的酒吧常客现在改在一家安静的咖啡馆与朋友见面。

entries.en: Access to the warehouse became her strongest bargaining counter in the negotiations.
entries.zh: 能够使用仓库成了她在谈判中最有力的筹码。

entries.en: The barrow boy covered his fruit when the drizzle began.
entries.zh: 开始下毛毛雨时，手推车货郎把水果盖了起来。

entries.en: Afternoon light revealed the delicate leaves in the bas-relief above the doorway.
entries.zh: 午后的光线映出了门口上方浅浮雕中那些精致的叶片。

entries.en: The fictional bank raised its quoted rate by a single basis point.
entries.zh: 故事中的银行把所报利率上调了一个基点。

entries.en: I hung the damp bathmat over the rail to dry.
entries.zh: 我把湿浴室防滑垫搭在横杆上晾干。

entries.en: The witness described the beating-up without identifying any of the attackers.
entries.zh: 证人描述了那场毒打，但没有指认任何袭击者。

entries.en: She designed three evening gowns for a local beauty contest.
entries.zh: 她为当地的一场选美比赛设计了三件晚礼服。

entries.en: The documentary follows several contestants preparing for a beauty pageant.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片跟拍了几位准备参加选美大赛的选手。

entries.en: The former beauty queen answered questions about her stage costumes.
entries.zh: 那位前选美冠军回答了有关自己舞台服装的问题。

entries.en: She refused to remain at her manager's beck and call all weekend.
entries.zh: 她拒绝整个周末都随时听候经理差遣。

entries.en: The parent asked the nurse about bedwetting during a private conversation.
entries.zh: 那位家长在一次私下交谈中向护士询问了尿床的问题。

entries.en: His old jacket would no longer button over his beer belly.
entries.zh: 他那件旧夹克如今被啤酒肚撑得扣不上了。

entries.en: The actor wore padding to give his character a beer gut.
entries.zh: 那位演员垫了衬料，让自己扮演的角色显出啤酒肚。

entries.en: Someone had written a telephone number on the back of the beermat.
entries.zh: 有人在那张啤酒杯垫的背面写了一个电话号码。

entries.en: In the illustration, a stray dog sniffs the empty begging bowl.
entries.zh: 插图中，一条流浪狗正嗅着那只空行乞碗。

entries.en: He sent a begging letter to a relative, asking for a loan after losing his income.
entries.zh: 失去收入后，他给一位亲戚写了封求借钱的信。

entries.en: The memoir questions whether the family's benign neglect was really helpful.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录质疑，那个家庭善意的忽视是否真的有帮助。

entries.en: The workshop compared best practice with the shortcuts used in our office.
entries.zh: 这次工作坊比较了最佳做法与我们办公室所用的省事办法。

entries.en: The club introduced a rule against betting on its own matches.
entries.zh: 俱乐部制定了一条规则，禁止在本俱乐部的比赛上下注。

entries.en: My onion bhaji arrived crisp and hot beside a small salad.
entries.zh: 我的洋葱印式炸菜饼端上来时酥脆滚烫，旁边配着一小份沙拉。

entries.en: She missed the silence of home after moving to the big city.
entries.zh: 搬到大城市后，她想念起家乡的宁静。

entries.en: The big head insisted that his idea had saved the entire project.
entries.zh: 那个自大的人坚持说，是他的主意挽救了整个项目。

entries.en: I should never have trusted that big mouth with a secret.
entries.zh: 我真不该把秘密告诉那个多嘴的人。

entries.en: The festival attracted a big name but gave most stage time to newcomers.
entries.zh: 这个节日活动请来了一位名人，但把大部分演出时间留给了新人。

entries.en: He acts like a big noise whenever visitors tour the office.
entries.zh: 每当有访客参观办公室，他都摆出一副大人物的架势。

entries.en: Delivery vans had blocked the bike lane outside the station.
entries.zh: 几辆送货车堵住了车站外的自行车道。

entries.en: The costume's rough seam rubbed against her bikini line during rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时，戏服上粗糙的接缝摩擦着她的比基尼线部位。

entries.en: The class compared biological diversity in two small woodland plots.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两小块林地中的生物多样性。

entries.en: A biotechnologist joined the meeting to discuss the proposed research facilities.
entries.zh: 一位生物工艺学家参加了会议，讨论拟建的研究设施。

entries.en: The reporter prepared questions about bird flu before interviewing the veterinarian.
entries.zh: 记者在采访兽医前准备了有关禽流感的问题。

entries.en: A squirrel reached the bird table before any birds appeared.
entries.zh: 鸟儿还没出现，一只松鼠就先爬上了鸟食台。

entries.en: The bird-watcher waited behind a screen with her notebook open.
entries.zh: 那位野鸟观察者躲在遮挡物后等待，笔记本摊在面前。

entries.en: A sudden shower brought our morning of bird-watching to an early end.
entries.zh: 一场突如其来的阵雨让我们那天上午的观鸟活动提前结束了。

entries.en: The play portrays the two dishonest merchants as birds of a feather.
entries.zh: 这出戏把那两个不诚实的商人描写成一丘之貉。

entries.en: I found the missing screw among the bits and pieces in the drawer.
entries.zh: 我在抽屉里的零碎物品中找到了那颗丢失的螺丝。

entries.en: His repeated lateness was a black mark against an otherwise strong application.
entries.zh: 他屡次迟到，让原本很有竞争力的申请有了一个污点。

entries.en: The children counted backwards while waiting for the rocket's blast-off.
entries.zh: 孩子们一边倒数，一边等待火箭发射升空。

entries.en: Please write the destination in block capitals so the driver can read it.
entries.zh: 请用正体大写字母写出目的地，方便司机看清。

entries.en: Her name appeared in neat block letters above the locker.
entries.zh: 她的名字以整齐的印刷体大写字母写在储物柜上方。

entries.en: The novel condemns the crowd's blood lust rather than celebrating the violence.
entries.zh: 这部小说谴责人群的杀戮欲，而不是歌颂暴力。

entries.en: The mediator feared that another failed meeting would lead to further blood-letting.
entries.zh: 调解人担心，再有一次会议失败，就会导致更多流血冲突。

entries.en: His blue jeans were still damp when the train arrived.
entries.zh: 火车到站时，他的牛仔裤还是湿的。

entries.en: The young baker hoped to win the blue riband at the village competition.
entries.zh: 那位年轻面包师希望在村里的比赛中夺得一等奖。

entries.en: The director's blue-eyed boy received another chance despite the poor reviews.
entries.zh: 尽管评价不佳，导演的宠儿还是又得到了一次机会。

entries.en: The exhibition records the journeys of boat people through interviews and photographs.
entries.zh: 这场展览通过访谈和照片记录了乘船外逃的难民的旅程。

entries.en: He learned boatbuilding from a craftsperson who worked beside the harbour.
entries.zh: 他向一位在港口旁工作的手艺人学习了造船术。

entries.en: Losing the venue was a body blow to the small theatre company.
entries.zh: 失去演出场地，对那个小剧团是个沉重的打击。

entries.en: The witness asked who had authorised the body search described in the report.
entries.zh: 证人问，是谁批准了报告中所描述的那次搜身。

entries.en: She wore a black bodysuit beneath the costume's loose outer layer.
entries.zh: 她在戏服宽松的外层下面穿了一件黑色紧身连体衣。

entries.en: He unwrapped a boiled sweet as the coach pulled away.
entries.zh: 长途客车开动时，他剥开了一颗硬糖的糖纸。

entries.en: The mechanic hung her stained boiler suit beside the workshop door.
entries.zh: 机械师把沾满污渍的连体工作服挂在了车间门旁。

entries.en: The abandoned shed became the character's bolthole whenever trouble reached the village.
entries.zh: 每当麻烦降临村子，那间废弃棚屋就成了这个角色的藏身处。

entries.en: The fictional police unit waited for the bomb disposal team to arrive.
entries.zh: 故事中的警察小队等待排爆组到来。

entries.en: Her years of unpaid work helped establish her bona fides with the committee.
entries.zh: 她多年来无偿工作的经历，帮助委员会相信了她的诚意。

entries.meaningZh: 优惠售书的读书俱乐部
entries.en: Our book club offers members a discount on each monthly selection.
entries.zh: 我们的读书俱乐部为会员每月选购的书提供折扣。

entries.en: A handwritten notice directed passengers to the temporary booking office.
entries.zh: 一张手写告示指引乘客前往临时售票处。

entries.en: The museum's bookmaking workshop began with folding sheets for a simple notebook.
entries.zh: 博物馆的制书工作坊从折叠纸张、制作一本简单的笔记本开始。

entries.en: They moved the booster seat from the kitchen chair before setting the table.
entries.zh: 摆餐具前，他们把增高座椅从厨房的椅子上移开了。

entries.en: The bottle shop owner stacked empty cartons beside the back entrance.
entries.zh: 瓶装酒商店的店主把空纸箱堆在后门旁。

entries.en: We found the bottle-opener beneath a pile of clean napkins.
entries.zh: 我们在一叠干净餐巾下面找到了开瓶器。

entries.en: The children queued beside the bouncy castle until the supervisor waved them forward.
entries.zh: 孩子们在充气城堡旁排队，直到看管人员招手让他们往前走。

entries.en: She tied the bouquet garni securely before lowering it into the soup.
entries.zh: 她把香草束扎紧后才放进汤里。

entries.en: Each volunteer received a box lunch before leaving for the afternoon shift.
entries.zh: 每位志愿者在出发去值下午班之前，都领到了一份盒装午餐。

entries.en: He packed two pairs of boxer shorts in the side pocket.
entries.zh: 他在侧袋里装了两条平角内裤。

entries.en: In the film, a boy racer learns to take responsibility after losing his licence.
entries.zh: 电影中，一名飙车小子在失去驾照后学会了承担责任。

entries.en: A single brandy snap cracked as I filled it with cream.
entries.zh: 我往里面填奶油时，有一只白兰地姜饼裂开了。

entries.en: Her brass rubbing captured every tiny letter around the knight's shield.
entries.zh: 她的铜牌拓片清楚地呈现出骑士盾牌周围的每一个细小字母。

entries.meaningZh: 成名的年轻演员或作家群体
entries.en: The magazine interviewed a new brat pack of young novelists.
entries.zh: 杂志采访了一批新近成名的年轻小说家。

entries.en: Someone had left the bread bin open beside the toaster.
entries.zh: 有人把烤面包机旁的面包盒敞着，没有关上。

entries.en: The student marked the break-even point on her imaginary business's chart.
entries.zh: 那名学生在自己虚构企业的图表上标出了收支平衡点。

entries.en: He kept breakfast television on while looking for his car keys.
entries.zh: 他一边找车钥匙，一边开着早餐时段的电视节目。

entries.en: The officer recorded the time of the breath test in her notebook.
entries.zh: 那名警官在笔记本中记下了呼吸测试的时间。

entries.en: A damaged breeze-block lay beside the unfinished garden wall.
entries.zh: 一块破损的轻型砌块放在尚未完工的花园围墙旁。

entries.en: The case study compared a bridging loan with delaying the purchase.
entries.zh: 这个案例比较了申请临时过渡贷款与推迟购买这两种方案。

entries.en: Neighbours brought homemade cakes and used books to the bring-and-buy sale.
entries.zh: 邻居们带着自制蛋糕和二手书来参加自带物品义卖会。

entries.meaningZh: 表现良好所得的赞许〔口语〕
entries.en: Arriving early earned him a brownie point with the new supervisor.
entries.zh: 提前到场，为他赢得了新主管的一点赞许。

entries.en: A peeling bumper sticker was the only decoration on the old car.
entries.zh: 那辆旧车唯一的装饰是一张正在起皮的保险杠贴纸。

entries.en: The newspaper closed two regional bureaux but kept its central newsroom.
entries.zh: 那家报社关闭了两个地区办公室，但保留了中央新闻编辑部。

entries.en: Her business class ticket included a seat near the front of the cabin.
entries.zh: 她的商务舱机票所安排的座位靠近机舱前部。

entries.en: Keep your fingers away from the business end of the stapler.
entries.zh: 别把手指靠近订书机实际作业的那一端。

entries.en: A notice on the door listed the shop's revised business hours.
entries.zh: 门上的告示列出了商店调整后的营业时间。

entries.en: A local business person offered to sponsor the school's art exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位当地商人提出，愿意赞助学校的美术展览。

entries.en: The school postponed the busing arrangements until every family had replied.
entries.zh: 学校把公共汽车接送安排暂时搁置，等所有家庭回复后再定。

entries.en: A lone button mushroom rolled off the board before I could slice it.
entries.zh: 我还没来得及切，有一颗未张开的蘑菇就滚下了砧板。

entries.en: The report questions whether the proposed buy-back would satisfy existing shareholders.
entries.zh: 报告质疑，拟议中的回购能否令现有股东满意。

entries.en: The cabin crew waited by the door while the last passengers boarded.
entries.zh: 最后几名乘客登机时，机舱乘务组在门旁等候。

entries.en: The trainee repeated the call sign before sending the next radio message.
entries.zh: 那名学员在发送下一条无线电信息前，重复了一遍呼号。

entries.en: The tailor chose camel-hair for the client's winter coat.
entries.zh: 裁缝为客户的冬季外套选用了驼毛呢。

entries.en: We folded the table before driving the camper van out of the campsite.
entries.zh: 我们先把桌子折好，才开着野营车驶离营地。

entries.en: The dancers rehearsed the can-can until every kick matched the music.
entries.zh: 舞者们反复排练康康舞，直到每次踢腿都合上了音乐节拍。

entries.en: A strong wind forced us to abandon our plans for canoeing.
entries.zh: 强风迫使我们放弃了划独木舟的计划。

entries.en: The textbook separates capital gains from wages in its worked example.
entries.zh: 这本教材在例题中把资本收益与工资分开列示。

entries.en: The economist used a simple diagram to explain capital inflow.
entries.zh: 那位经济学家用一幅简单的图解释了资金流入。

entries.en: The old car phone remained mounted beside the dashboard after it stopped working.
entries.zh: 那部旧汽车电话停止工作后，仍固定在仪表盘旁。

entries.en: The witness could describe the car-jacker's coat but not his face.
entries.zh: 证人能够描述那名劫车者的外套，却说不清他的相貌。

entries.en: The class debated how a fictional company should account for a carbon credit.
entries.zh: 全班讨论了一家虚构公司应如何对一项碳信用进行记账。

entries.en: Our project compared the carbon footprint of two hypothetical delivery routes.
entries.zh: 我们的项目比较了两条假设配送路线的碳足迹。

entries.en: She chose carbon trading as the topic for her economics presentation.
entries.zh: 她选了碳排放权交易作为经济学报告的主题。

entries.en: In the novel, betraying a friend is the cardinal sin.
entries.zh: 在这部小说中，背叛朋友是最重大的罪过。

entries.en: The care home manager arranged a quiet room for family visits.
entries.zh: 护理中心的经理安排了一个安静房间，供家属探视。

entries.en: A care worker helped him find the cardigan he wanted to wear.
entries.zh: 一位护工帮他找到了他想穿的开衫。

entries.en: She took a career break to care for her father.
entries.zh: 她暂时离职，去照顾父亲。

entries.en: The memoir challenges the narrow image of the successful career woman.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录质疑了对成功职业女性的狭隘刻画。

entries.en: The queue at the cash desk stretched past the display of notebooks.
entries.zh: 付款台前的队伍一直排过了笔记本陈列区。

entries.en: The novel follows a castoff who gradually finds friendship in a coastal village.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一个被抛弃的人如何在海边村庄里逐渐找到友谊。

entries.en: The union questioned the proposed casualization of the factory's workforce.
entries.zh: 工会对拟将工厂用工改为临时工制的计划提出了质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 有权力的有利地位〔美式口语〕
entries.en: The new voting rules put the chair firmly in the catbird seat.
entries.zh: 新的投票规则让主席稳稳地占据了有权力的有利地位。

entries.en: The comedian's catch-phrase appeared on posters throughout the station.
entries.zh: 车站到处张贴的海报上都印着那位喜剧演员的招牌口头禅。

entries.en: The cattery asked us to label the bag containing our cat's blanket.
entries.zh: 猫寄养舍让我们在装着自家猫毯子的袋子上做好标记。

entries.en: The farmer left the cattle prod hanging beside the empty pen.
entries.zh: 农场主把赶牛棒挂在了空畜栏旁。

entries.meaningZh: 道路中央分隔带〔英式英语〕
entries.en: Wildflowers grew along the central reservation beyond the junction.
entries.zh: 路口那边的道路中央分隔带上长着野花。

entries.en: She moved the chaise lounge away from the window before the rain began.
entries.zh: 开始下雨前，她把躺椅从窗边移开了。

entries.en: The museum displayed a decorated chamber pot among the household objects.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一只带装饰的便壶与其他家用物品一起展出。

entries.en: His unexpected change of heart surprised everyone planning the trip.
entries.zh: 他突然改变心意，让所有正在筹划旅行的人都感到惊讶。

entries.en: She searched her change purse for a coin small enough for the machine.
entries.zh: 她在零钱包里找一枚能投进那台机器的硬币。

entries.en: I left my umbrella outside the changing room by mistake.
entries.zh: 我不小心把伞忘在了更衣室外面。

entries.en: An hour of channel-hopping left us without anything we wanted to watch.
entries.zh: 我们换了一个小时的电视频道，还是没找到想看的节目。

entries.en: She demanded chapter and verse before accepting his version of the dispute.
entries.zh: 她要求提供详尽的引证，才肯接受他对那场争执的说法。

entries.en: The guided tour ended inside the cathedral's quiet chapter house.
entries.zh: 导览最后在大教堂安静的教士会礼堂内结束。

entries.en: Poor character recognition left several dates unreadable in the scanned letter.
entries.zh: 字符识别效果不佳，导致扫描信件中的几个日期无法辨读。

entries.en: I donated the unused coat to the charity shop near the library.
entries.zh: 我把那件没穿过的外套捐给了图书馆附近的慈善商店。

entries.en: The manager launched a charm offensive after the staff rejected his first proposal.
entries.zh: 员工否决他的第一个提案后，经理发起了一轮讨好攻势。

entries.meaningZh: 外人难以进入的小圈子
entries.en: Even after joining the firm, she remained outside the partners' charmed circle.
entries.zh: 即使加入公司后，她仍然没能进入合伙人那个封闭的小圈子。

entries.en: The presenter invited lonely listeners to try the station's evening chatline.
entries.zh: 主持人邀请感到孤独的听众尝试电台晚间的聊天热线。

entries.en: A chemical engineer reviewed the proposed layout before the team ordered equipment.
entries.zh: 团队订购设备前，一位化学工程师审查了拟议的布局。

entries.en: He found his cheque book beneath a stack of unopened letters.
entries.zh: 他在一叠未拆封的信下面找到了支票簿。

entries.en: The old wallet still contained an expired cheque card.
entries.zh: 那只旧钱包里还装着一张过期的支票卡。

entries.meaningZh: 面向女性观众的浪漫电影〔非正式，可能含轻蔑〕
entries.en: She disliked hearing her favourite film dismissed as a chick flick.
entries.zh: 她不喜欢听别人把她最爱的电影轻蔑地称作女性言情片。

entries.en: The family kept the child benefit letters in a separate folder.
entries.zh: 这家人把有关儿童津贴的信件放在一个单独的文件夹里。

entries.en: The children planted sunflowers in the narrow strip beside the fence.
entries.zh: 孩子们在篱笆旁那条狭长地带种下了向日葵。

entries.en: A loose chimney pot had tilted after the overnight storm.
entries.zh: 一只松动的烟囱管帽在夜间的暴风雨后歪了。

entries.en: The old chimney stack stood above the empty mill buildings.
entries.zh: 那座旧大烟囱耸立在空置的磨坊建筑上方。

entries.en: The chimney sweep spread a cloth across the hearth before starting work.
entries.zh: 烟囱清扫工在开始工作前，先把一块布铺在壁炉前。

entries.en: The chip shop stayed open after the final performance ended.
entries.zh: 最后一场演出结束后，那家炸鱼薯条店还在营业。

entries.en: The chirping outside my window stopped when a cat crossed the garden.
entries.zh: 一只猫穿过花园时，我窗外的鸟鸣声停止了。

entries.en: After an hour of churning, the apprentice stopped to rest her arms.
entries.zh: 搅乳一个小时后，学徒停下来，让双臂歇一歇。

entries.en: We rearranged the hall to leave enough space for circuit training.
entries.zh: 我们重新布置了礼堂，腾出足够的空间进行循环训练。

entries.en: The archive contains posters from a local civil defence campaign.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着当地一次民防宣传活动的海报。

entries.en: The students debated how the fictional law might affect civil liberties.
entries.zh: 学生们讨论了那项虚构法律可能如何影响公民自由权。

entries.en: Her essay compared two speeches about civil rights without quoting either at length.
entries.zh: 她的文章比较了两篇有关公民权利的演讲，没有大段引用其中任何一篇。

entries.en: Her speech became a clarion call for volunteers to rebuild the theatre.
entries.zh: 她的演讲成为一声振奋人心的号召，激励志愿者重建剧院。

entries.en: Our weekend clear-out uncovered a box of old family photographs.
entries.zh: 周末清理杂物时，我们找到了一盒旧家庭照片。

entries.en: The textbook follows a fictional payment through a clearing bank.
entries.zh: 教材用一个虚构付款案例说明了款项经过清算银行的过程。

entries.en: The historian questions whether the fictional kingdom functions as a client state.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家质疑，故事中的王国是否实际上充当了附庸国。

entries.en: The gamekeeper checked the signs announcing the close season.
entries.zh: 猎场看守检查了告示禁猎期的标牌。

entries.en: The folded clothes horse fitted behind the washing machine.
entries.zh: 折好的晾衣架能放在洗衣机后面。

entries.en: An enthusiastic clubber volunteered to organise the members' annual dinner.
entries.zh: 一位热心的俱乐部会员主动提出，愿意筹办会员年度晚宴。

entries.en: She found a co-religionist willing to discuss the festival's traditions with her.
entries.zh: 她找到了一位愿意与她讨论节日传统的同教信徒。

entries.en: A coach-load of visitors arrived just as the museum opened.
entries.zh: 博物馆刚开门，一客车的游客就到了。

entries.en: His coat-tails caught on the chair as he stood to bow.
entries.zh: 他站起来鞠躬时，上衣后摆挂住了椅子。

entries.meaningZh: 混乱；搞砸的局面〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: The missing tickets turned a simple outing into a complete cock-up.
entries.zh: 丢失的票把一次简单的外出弄得一团糟。

entries.en: Every volunteer received the centre's code of practice before beginning a shift.
entries.zh: 每名志愿者在开始值班前，都拿到了该中心的业务守则。

entries.en: The receiver rejected the corrupted code word in the classroom demonstration.
entries.zh: 在课堂演示中，接收器拒绝了那个损坏的代码字。

entries.en: A quiet coffee house stood opposite the second-hand bookshop.
entries.zh: 二手书店对面有一家安静的咖啡馆。

entries.en: The neighbours organised a coffee morning to welcome the new residents.
entries.zh: 邻居们组织了一次咖啡早茶会，欢迎新住户。

entries.en: Colada wrapped the spare cups in newspaper before moving the box.
entries.zh: 科拉达在搬箱子前，先用报纸包好了备用杯子。

entries.meaningZh: 向潜在客户打的陌生推销电话
entries.en: A cold call interrupted our discussion just before we reached a decision.
entries.zh: 就在我们即将作出决定时，一通陌生推销电话打断了讨论。

entries.en: The porter checked the cold store door before locking the building.
entries.zh: 搬运工在锁上大楼前，检查了冷藏库的门。

entries.en: The collection box beneath the chute was already half full.
entries.zh: 滑槽下方的收集箱已经装了一半。

entries.en: The seminar discussed the collective unconscious as a concept in psychology.
entries.zh: 研讨课讨论了集体无意识这个心理学概念。

entries.en: The reviewer argued that colorization had changed the film's visual atmosphere.
entries.zh: 评论者认为，着色处理改变了这部影片的视觉氛围。

entries.en: He mentioned his colour-blindness when the designer asked about the colour scheme.
entries.zh: 设计师询问配色方案时，他提到了自己的色盲情况。

entries.en: She kept the folded map in a pocket of her combat trousers.
entries.zh: 她把折好的地图放在了作战裤的一个口袋里。

entries.en: The combine harvester stood under cover while the rain continued.
entries.zh: 雨一直下着，那台联合收割机停在遮盖处。

entries.en: From the balcony, we watched the comings and goings in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 我们在阳台上看着院子里的人来来往往。

entries.meaningZh: 中央管理的经济；指令经济
entries.en: The class compared a command economy with a market-based model.
entries.zh: 全班把指令经济与一种以市场为基础的模式作了比较。

entries.en: The memoir describes the nervous preparations for a command performance.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录描写了筹备御前演出时的紧张情景。

entries.meaningZh: 社区教育中心；社区礼堂
entries.en: The community centre lent us a classroom for the evening language course.
entries.zh: 社区中心借给我们一间教室，用于晚间语言课程。

entries.en: Residents asked questions about community policing at the monthly meeting.
entries.zh: 居民们在月度会议上提出了有关社区警务的问题。

entries.en: He returned the company car after clearing the last boxes from his office.
entries.zh: 他搬出办公室里最后几箱东西后，归还了公司配车。

entries.en: In the novel, an old comrade-in-arms recognises him at the harbour.
entries.zh: 小说中，一位老战友在港口认出了他。

entries.en: A concertgoer returned the programme I had dropped beside my seat.
entries.zh: 一位常听音乐会的观众把我掉在座位旁的节目单还给了我。

entries.en: The fictional prisoner receives a final letter in his condemned cell.
entries.zh: 故事中的囚犯在死囚牢房里收到了一封最后的来信。

entries.en: The driver asked whether the hire agreement covered the congestion charge.
entries.zh: 司机问，租用协议是否包含了交通拥堵费。

entries.en: The council's fictional transport plan includes a debate about congestion charging.
entries.zh: 那份虚构的市议会交通计划包含了对交通拥堵收费的讨论。

entries.en: The pupils drew a map of the paths inside the conservation area.
entries.zh: 学生们绘制了一幅保护区内步道的地图。

entries.en: A small box of chocolates served as the consolation prize.
entries.zh: 一小盒巧克力被用作安慰奖。

entries.en: The podcast traced the origins of a conspiracy theory without endorsing it.
entries.zh: 那档播客追溯了一种阴谋论的起源，但并不认可它。

entries.meaningZh: 制宪或修宪的国民代表大会
entries.en: The historical novel follows a delegate to a constituent assembly.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说围绕一名参加制宪大会的代表展开。
